text:
elaine: FYI customer hit an ImportError after installing the Python SDK with poetry extras. They run `from redwood import Client` and get `ImportError: cannot import name 'AsyncClient' from 'httpx'`. Happened right after `poetry install`. Any quick repro / fix?

josh: Sounds like an httpx version mismatch. Can you paste their `poetry.lock` or `pip freeze` and which `redwood-sdk` version they installed?

elaine: Customer pasted `pip freeze` snippet:

```text
redwood-sdk==1.2.7
httpx==0.21.1
uvicorn==0.18.3
...
```

They said they used `poetry add redwood-sdk` then `poetry install` on Python 3.10. Our docs expect `httpx>=0.23` for the AsyncClient surface.

sam: Yup — AsyncClient behavior we rely on was stabilized in httpx 0.23+. Older 0.21 won't have the same API. Two immediate routes: pin httpx>=0.23 in their project, or create an isolated venv and pip install a compatible set. For poetry do: `poetry add "httpx@^0.23.3"` so lockfile will update.

josh: Minimal repro Dockerfile I used to validate:

```Dockerfile
FROM python:3.10-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY pyproject.toml poetry.lock ./
RUN pip install poetry && poetry install --no-dev
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "from redwood import Client; print('ok')"]
```

If `poetry.lock` pins `httpx<0.23` the import fails.

elaine: Customer tried pinning but says an internal dependency forces `httpx==0.21.1`. They can't easily upgrade that dep. Any other workaround?

sam: If a transitive dep pins httpx you can: 1) ask upstream to loosen constraint, 2) use a separate environment for the service that uses redwood-sdk, or 3) vendor a supported httpx into your app (ugly). For immediate relief we recommended:

```bash
# using poetry
poetry remove httpx || true
poetry add "httpx>=0.23.3"
poetry add redwood-sdk@1.2.7
# or pip approach in venv
pip install --upgrade 'httpx==0.23.3' 'redwood-sdk==1.2.7'
```

josh: I'm also checking our packaging. I suspect our async extras don't correctly pin the httpx minimum (or the extras name mismatch). Filing a package bug so we get a quick patch.

support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-4821. Internal engineering issue INF-1297 linked and eng-pkg notified.

elaine: Customer accepted the temporary venv workaround and asked for a permanent fix from us (clearer requirements + a new release). Can we add an explicit `httpx>=0.23.3` requirement for the async extras and a short compatibility note in release notes?

josh: Agreed. Plan: patch pyproject to include `httpx>=0.23.3` in the async extras and add unit tests covering poetry lock scenarios. Target patch release 1.2.8. Also add a more helpful import-time error that hints at "httpx version mismatch".

sam: I'll open the PR and tag eng-pkg / eng-runtime. ETA EOD tomorrow to have tests and CI passing.

elaine: Thanks — I'll update the customer and close once 1.2.8 is out. :thumbsup:
